result:
I added `GET /orders/:id` in `src/app.ts`. Typecheck passes and all 7 tests pass, including a new one for this endpoint.

- **Response:** it returns `id`, `status`, `total_cents` and `created_at`, plus an `items` array. Each item has `product_id`, `quantity` and `price_cents`, ordered by `product_id`.
- **Ownership:** it only returns orders belonging to the caller. Another user's order gives the same 404 as a missing one, so order IDs can't be probed.
- **Bad IDs:** a non-numeric or out-of-range ID gives a 404 in the standard error format (`not_found`), not a 500 from Postgres.

The new test in `test/app.test.ts` covers the caller's own order, another user's order (404) and a non-numeric ID (404). It doesn't check the contents of `items`, because I didn't look at the seed data.

I didn't touch the Postman collection (`postman/shop-api.postman_collection.json`), so the new route isn't in it yet.
